capabilities: Render fountain code blocks as laid-out screenplay pages
Format scene headings, characters, dual dialogue, transitions and title pages
Toggle display of title page, scene numbers, sections, synopses and notes in settings
Switch between a paper-like page style and inline rendering
disambiguation: Not a standalone Fountain editor; it only renders fountain code blocks inside Markdown notes and doesn't touch whole .fountain files.
extras: Not yet in Obsidian's community plugin directory; installs via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Uses Courier Prime font when available, falling back to Courier New or Courier.
problem: Obsidian shows Fountain screenplay text as plain text with no script-style layout for scene headings, dialogue and transitions.

relations.evidence: Screenplay parsing by fountain-js, by Jonny Greenwald and contributors (MIT).

summary: Code block renderer that displays Fountain screenplay markup as a formatted screenplay page inside Markdown notes, in Reading view and Live Preview.
